description: Swing-like joint configurations for surface checks: changes of model coordinates (radians) added to address_pose.json. They are not fitted to a swing and close no grip; each turns the pelvis, the trunk, the arms and the legs about as far as that phase of a swing does.
skinned_hand_wrists_description: Wrist coordinates (radians, not changes) of full_body_spec_anthro_driver.json with the skinned hands rigid on the club, at which the hands are turned against the forearms as at the top of the downswing and the finish of a fitted driver swing: the lead hand 62 to 66 degrees, the trail hand 96 to 100 degrees (bends with a twist about the forearm).
